parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
allocate[aelakeit]v.
To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.
→ The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
😎
appetizing[aepitaizirj]adj.
When food is appetizing, it looks and smells very good.
→ The appetizing plate of cookies was gone in half an hour.
😎
blizzard[blizard]n.
A blizzard is a severe snow storm with strong winds.
→ We did not dare to go outside during the terrible blizzard.
😎
cavity[kaavati]n.
A cavity is a hole or space in something.
→ There was a small cavity in the wall of the cave where an animal lived.
😎
clockwise[klakwaiz]adv.
If something moves clockwise, it moves in a circle in the same direction as a clock.
→ Turn the screw clockwise to tighten it.
😎
concentric[kansentrik]adj.
When circles or rings are concentric, they have the same center.
→ The target was a series of concentric circles.
😎
courtesy[ko:rtasi]n.
Courtesy is the excellence of manners or social conduct.
→ Jenna always behaves with great courtesy when people visit her home.
😎
crisp[krisp]adj.
When food is crisp, it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.
→ My favorite snack is a bag of crisp, delicious potato chips.
😎
discord[disko:rd]n.
Discord is disagreement or fighting between people.
→ There was much discord between the experts on the talk show.
😎
frigid[frid3id]adj.
When something is frigid, it is extremely cold.
→ We decided not to go on the hike because the weather was too frigid.
😎
generate[d3enareit]v.
To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.
→ The mayor promised to generate new jobs and programs to help the poor.
😎
glacial[gleijal]adj.
When something is glacial, it relates to large masses of ice that move slowly.
→ Penguins thrive in the glacial regions of Antarctica.
😎
interchange[intartjeind3]n.
An interchange of ideas between people is a discussion of each person’s idea.
→ There was an interchange of ideas between the groups.
😎
locker[lakar]n.
A locker is a small cabinet with a lock where people store their possessions.
→ I keep my school books in my locker.
😎
multicultural[mAltikAltjaral]adj.
When something is multicultural, it relates to many different cultures.
→ Everyone was welcomed to attend the multicultural celebration.
😎
omission[oumijen]n.
An omission is something that has been left out or not done.
→ Mike was upset because of the omission of his name during the ceremony.
😎
oversee[ouvarsi:]v.
To oversee something means to make sure that it is being done properly.
→ His job was to oversee the progress of the construction project.
😎
pierce[piars]v.
To pierce something means to make a hole in it using a sharp object.
→ The arrow pierced the target in the very center.
😎
replicate[replakeit]v.
To replicate something is to do it in the exact same way as someone before.
→ I would love to replicate my father’s achievements in school.
😎
wavy[weivi]adj.
When something is wavy, it is not straight but has a series of curves.
→ The child drew wavy lines all over the piece of paper.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: 1. frigid
questions.explanation: frigid (extremely cold) is the opposite of hot.

questions.content: 2. wavy
questions.explanation: wavy is the opposite of straight.

questions.content: 3. crisp
questions.explanation: crisp (hard in a pleasant way) is the opposite of soft.

questions.content: 4. replicate
questions.explanation: replicate (to do it in the exact same way as someone before) is the opposite of original.

questions.content: 5. allocate
questions.explanation: allocate (put aside for a purpose) is the opposite of take away.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. No one else can open my <u><u>small cabinet with a lock</u>.</u> [ 6 ]
questions.explanation: locker (n): a small cabinet with a lock.

questions.content: 2. How can we prevent <u>argument and <u>disagreement</u> in</u> the future? [ 7 ]
questions.explanation: discord (n): disagreement or fighting.

questions.content: 3. The brave travelers were not stopped by <u>the <u>snow storm with strong winds</u>.</u> [ 8 ]
questions.explanation: blizzard (n): a severe snow storm with strong winds.

questions.content: 4. The organizers made sure that the parade was <u><u>related to many different cultures</u>.</u> [ 9 ]
questions.explanation: multicultural (adj): relating to many different cultures.

questions.content: 5. The thief hid the money in a <u>small <u>hole</u> in the</u> wall. [ 10 ]
questions.explanation: cavity (n): a hole or space in something.

questions.content: 6. I thought the hosts showed a <u>lot of <u>politeness and respect</u> for others</u>. [ 11 ]
questions.explanation: courtesy (n): excellence of manners or social conduct.

questions.content: 7. It was her job to <u><u>make sure everything was being done properly</u></u> on the project. [ 12 ]
questions.explanation: oversee (v): make sure that it is being done properly.

questions.content: 8. What can we do <u>to <u>cause the beginning</u> or development</u> of interest in our product? [ 13 ]
questions.explanation: generate (v): to cause it to develop or begin.

questions.content: 9. People cannot withstand <u><u>extremely cold</u></u> temperatures without clothing and shelter. [ 14 ]
questions.explanation: frigid (adj): extremely cold.

questions.content: 10. John used a knife to <u><u>make a hole</u> in the</u> thick rubber. [ 15 ]
questions.explanation: pierce (v): make a hole in it using a sharp object.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: 1. This is a <u>multicultural</u> holiday. People from all over the world celebrate it.
questions.explanation: multicultural: relates to many different cultures.

questions.content: 2. The valuables are kept in a secure <u>locker</u>.
questions.explanation: locker: a small cabinet with a lock.

questions.content: 3. If things move <u>clockwise</u>, they move in reverse.
questions.explanation: clockwise: moves in a circle in the same direction as a clock, not reverse.

questions.content: 4. The doctor <u>pierced</u> his skin with the needle to draw blood.
questions.explanation: pierce: to make a hole in it using a sharp object.

questions.content: 5. The scientist tried to <u>replicate</u> the experiment and compare the results.
questions.explanation: replicate: to do it in the exact same way.

questions.content: 6. The <u>cavity</u> quickly traveled down the stream and to the lake.
questions.explanation: cavity: a hole or space, which doesn't travel down a stream.

questions.content: 7. The <u>frigid</u> soup burned my tongue!
questions.explanation: frigid: extremely cold, so it wouldn't burn a tongue.

questions.content: 8. School was cancelled today because of the horrible <u>blizzard</u> outside.
questions.explanation: blizzard: a severe snow storm.

questions.content: 9. The <u>appetizing</u> scene made everyone in the theater cry.
questions.explanation: appetizing: looks and smells very good (for food), not related to a sad movie scene.

questions.content: 10. After a brief <u>interchange</u> of ideas, we were ready to begin the new project.
questions.explanation: interchange: a discussion of each person's idea.

questions.content: 11. Make sure to include an <u>omission</u> of our goals in the presentation.
questions.explanation: omission: something left out or not done, which contradicts 'include'.

questions.content: 12. The charity raised money for all of the <u>wavy</u> children in the city.
questions.explanation: wavy: not straight but has a series of curves, doesn't describe children.

questions.content: 13. Tim was chosen to <u>oversee</u> the progress of the building crew.
questions.explanation: oversee: make sure that it is being done properly.

questions.content: 14. The <u>glacial</u> dog loved to run and chase the ball in the park.
questions.explanation: glacial: relates to large masses of ice that move slowly, doesn't describe a running dog.

questions.content: 15. We need to <u>generate</u> a new plan because this one isn't going to work.
questions.explanation: generate: cause to develop or begin.

questions.content: 16. He was not pleased with the movie. He thought it was too <u>concentric</u>.
questions.explanation: concentric: having the same center, doesn't make sense for a movie.

questions.content: 17. The brothers cannot work together. There is always <u>discord</u> between them.
questions.explanation: discord: disagreement or fighting.

questions.content: 18. The <u>crisp</u> lettuce went well with the sandwich.
questions.explanation: crisp: hard or has a hard surface in a pleasant way.

questions.content: 19. The mother was disappointed with the extreme <u>courtesy</u> her children displayed.
questions.explanation: courtesy: excellence of manners, which a mother would not be disappointed by.

questions.content: 20. Seats will be <u>allocated</u> to the people who are the first to arrive.
questions.explanation: allocate: put aside for a certain purpose or person.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Ice House

Last year, Erik constructed one of the world's strangest houses in the glacial landscape of northern Sweden. He called it the Ice House: a house made entirely of ice and snow. All of the beds, chairs, tables, and walls are cold, hard sculptures of ice.

A group of architects and volunteers from all over the world traveled to the site of the Ice House and began its construction. The multicultural group journeyed through blizzards and frigid temperatures to reach the site. Once the builders arrived, there was an interchange of ideas, and tools were allocated to each worker. An expert was selected to oversee the building process to make sure there was no discord between the workers. Once a plan was generated, they got right to work. The design was very unique; the builders couldn't replicate the design from normal houses.

The first step was to build the walls and ceiling. The builders used a metal frame to help them build the structure. After the ice was in place, the frame was removed. The builders then created furniture and art pieces. Designs were carved into each piece. One worker carved big wavy lines, and another made tiny clockwise, concentric circles. Finally, the workers carved small cavities in the roof and inserted colored lights. When the work was finished, the beautiful house was ready for a resident to enjoy.

Living in the Ice House is an experience like no other. Erik stores his belongings in an ice locker and lays out a sleeping bag on his ice bed. At dinner, he dines on a delicious salad with crisp toppings. And for the main course, he enjoys appetizing fish caught from a nearby river. The fish are pierced with icicles and served on ice plates. After dinner, he gets ready for a cold night. The omission of heaters can be too much for his visitors sometimes. Luckily, there are warm rooms nearby, as a courtesy to people who get too cold.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: 1. A multicultural group traveled through blizzards and frigid temperatures to reach the site.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Đoạn 2 viết: "The multicultural group journeyed through blizzards and frigid temperatures to reach the site." (Nhóm đa văn hóa đã vượt qua những trận bão tuyết và nhiệt độ lạnh giá để đến được địa điểm này).

questions.content: 2. Erik dines on crisp, appetizing fish that are pierced with icicles.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Câu này kết hợp ý trong bài: cậu dùng bữa với salad có lớp phủ giòn (crisp toppings) và món cá ngon miệng (appetizing fish) được xiên qua bằng các nhũ băng (pierced with icicles).

questions.content: 3. The expert who oversaw the process made sure there wasn't discord in the glacial landscape.
questions.explanation: Sai. Đoạn 2 ghi rõ: "An expert was selected to oversee the building process to make sure there was no discord between the workers." (Một chuyên gia được chọn để giám sát quá trình xây dựng nhằm đảm bảo không có sự bất hòa giữa các công nhân). Không phải là không có sự bất hòa ở "vùng đất băng giá" (glacial landscape).

questions.content: 4. One worker carved big wavy lines, and another made tiny clockwise, concentric circles.
questions.explanation: Đúng. Đoạn 3 có viết: "One worker carved big wavy lines, and another made tiny clockwise, concentric circles." (Một người thợ khắc những đường lượn sóng lớn, và một người khác tạo ra những vòng tròn nhỏ đồng tâm theo chiều kim đồng hồ).

questions.content: 5. The builders replicated the design from normal houses.
questions.explanation: Sai. Cuối đoạn 2 viết: "The design was very unique; the builders couldn't replicate the design from normal houses." (Thiết kế rất độc đáo; những người thợ xây không thể sao chép thiết kế từ những ngôi nhà bình thường).

questions.content: 1. What was allocated to the workers after an interchange of ideas?
options: Tools were allocated to each worker.
Colored lights were inserted in the cavities in the roof.
Nearby warm rooms were a courtesy to people who got too cold.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ: "Once the builders arrived, there was an interchange of ideas, and tools were allocated to each worker." (Khi những người thợ xây đến nơi, họ đã trao đổi ý tưởng và công cụ được phân phát cho từng công nhân). Đáp án A là đúng.

questions.content: 2. What was put in cavities in the roof?
options: Colored lights were inserted in the cavities in the roof.
Tools were allocated to each worker.
Erik stores his belongings in his ice locker.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3 có viết: "Finally, the workers carved small cavities in the roof and inserted colored lights." (Cuối cùng, những người thợ khoét các lỗ nhỏ trên mái nhà và lắp đèn màu vào). Vì thế đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: 3. What happened when a plan was generated?
options: Colored lights were inserted in the cavities in the roof.
Tools were allocated to each worker.
Erik stores his belongings in his ice locker.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 có câu: "Once a plan was generated, they got right to work." (Ngay khi một kế hoạch được tạo ra, họ liền bắt tay ngay vào làm việc). Do đó đáp án A là đúng.

questions.content: 4. What is provided as a courtesy when guests get too cold?
options: Nearby warm rooms were a courtesy to people who got too cold.
Tools were allocated to each worker.
Colored lights were inserted in the cavities in the roof.
questions.explanation: Cuối bài đọc ghi: "Luckily, there are warm rooms nearby, as a courtesy to people who get too cold." (May mắn thay, có những căn phòng ấm áp ở gần đó, như một sự ân cần dành cho những người bị quá lạnh). Vì vậy đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: 5. What did Erik put in his ice locker?
options: Erik stores his belongings in his ice locker.
Tools were allocated to each worker.
Colored lights were inserted in the cavities in the roof.
Nearby warm rooms were a courtesy to people who got too cold.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 có viết: "Erik stores his belongings in an ice locker..." (Erik cất giữ đồ đạc của mình trong một chiếc tủ đồ bằng băng...). Đáp án A là đúng.
